## Gutted (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
CE Medium undead  
**Init** +3; **Senses** low-light vision, darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +1  


**Defense**


**AC** 14, touch 13, flat-footed 11 (+3 Dex, +1 natural)  
**hp** 20 (3d8+6)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +4, **Will** +4  
**Immune** undead immunities; **Resist** acid 15  
**Vulnerable** slashing damage  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** +4 slam (1d6+2 bludgeoning plus 1d6 acid, 20/x2, plus grab)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 15, **Dex** 17, Con—, **Int** 2, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +4 (+6 grapple); **CMD** 17  
**Feats** Improved Grapple, Power Attack  
**Skills** Climb +7, Stealth +8  


**Special Abilities**


**Nauseating Grapple (Ex)** Any creature grappled by a gutted is nauseated 1 for as long as they remain grappled and for one round afterward, unless they succeed at a DC 13 **Fort** Save.  

**Squeeze (Ex)** A gutted can dissolve itself into a mass of squirming intestines, and pass through openings as small as 1-2 inches in diameter. It is considered flatfooted while squeezing.  



**Ecology**


**Environment** any urban or ruins  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** incidental
